Teaching Objectives
This module introduces the foundations of Machine Learning: types of learning, data preprocessing, pattern extraction, supervised classification, cross-validation, and model optimisation. Deep neural networks are covered in the "Deep Learning" module.
Prerequisites:
Mathematics: linear algebra, probability, statistics, etc.
Course Content (21h)
Chapter 1: Introduction and Fundamentals
Overview of Machine Learning
Types of ML and project lifecycle
Chapter 2: Data Preprocessing
Handling missing values and outliers
Normalisation, discretisation, encoding
Imbalanced datasets problem
Chapter 3: Regression
Linear regression (simple and multiple)
Regularisation (Ridge, Lasso)
Regression metrics (MAE, RMSE, R²)
Chapter 4: Classification
Simple perceptron
Decision trees and forests
k-Nearest Neighbours
Naïve Bayes
SVM (linear separators)
Chapter 5: Clustering
Similarity measures
k-means, hierarchical clustering (CAH)
DBSCAN
Clustering metrics (silhouette, Davies-Bouldin)
Chapter 6: Model Evaluation and Validation
Cross-validation (K-fold, leave-one-out)
Overfitting vs underfitting (learning curves)
Hyperparameter optimisation
Result interpretation (accuracy, precision, recall, F1)
Chapter 7: Frequent Patterns and Association Rules
Basic concepts
Methods for frequent pattern mining
Association rules
Sequential frequent patterns
Chapter 8: Feature Engineering and Anomaly Detection
Feature creation and selection
Dimensionality reduction (PCA)
Detection methods (Isolation Forest, LOF)
Chapter 9: Case Studies and AutoML
Project 1: advanced customer segmentation
Project 2: fraud detection
Introduction to AutoML (TPOT, Auto-sklearn)
Assessment
Final examination (in person): 60%
Continuous assessment (CC): 40% — tests, personal work
